en:
If everyone dead is really alive...we gotta
save them! No matter what!
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Gonta for a while?

Gonta be shield! Gonta be spear!
Gonta be whatever everyone need!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time trying to
calm down Gonta.
<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta and I grew a little closer today.
